name: Stipend of Rs. 500 per month for trainees in Craftsman Training Scheme in Govt ITI
description: Training under the Craftsmen Training Scheme is provided in 419 GITI and 575 PITI in Maharashtra. As of the Government Resolution (GR) dated 07/05/1983, 50% of trainees in GITI were granted a stipend of either Rs. 40 or Rs. 60 per month. Despite the increasing inflation rate, there has been no adjustment in the stipend over the past 40 years. According to the State Employment and Entrepreneurship Exchange and Self Employment Institute Development (SEEID) GR dated 13/09/2023, a decision has been made to provide a stipend of Rs. 500/- per month to all trainees (including Open, OBC, SBC, EWS, VJ-A/DT, NT-B, NT- C, NT-D, SC, ST) at GITI starting from the 2023-2024 session.
department: Skill Development, Employement And Entrepreneurship Department
implementingAuthority: Skill Development, Employement And Entrepreneurship Department
